mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate relative to its historical average compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings and consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During post-pandemic recovery phases, a sustained increase in housing starts above 1500 thousand units signals strong consumer confidence and residential investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during the post-pandemic recovery regime when HOUST > 1500, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production relative to its trend indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate profits and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1400 thousand units signals weak consumer demand and residential investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1400, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), a decline in the federal funds rate signals an aggressive monetary easing response that supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
